lessons.title: At home
lessons.description: 房间、家具与家里常用的礼貌表达

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Where is the bathroom, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It is next to the bedroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. I will open the window.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Please sit at the table.

lessons.title: At a café
lessons.description: 看菜单、点饮品餐食与结账买单

phrases.en: Could I see the menu, please?
phrases.zh: 可以让我看一下菜单吗？

phrases.en: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
Could I have some water, please?
Could we have the bill, please?
Would you like milk in your tea?
Could I have some bread, please?

phrases.zh: 我们就在这里吃午饭吧。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What would you like for lunch?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Some bread and a cup of tea, please.
dialogue.zh: 请给我一些面包和一杯茶。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Would you like milk in your tea?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, please. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, thank you.

lessons.title: Getting around
lessons.description: 买车票、找车站和听懂指路

phrases.en: Is the station on this street?
Turn right at the next street.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，请问车站在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Go straight. The train station is on the right.
dialogue.zh: 一直往前走。火车站在右边。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can I take a taxi there?
dialogue.zh: 我可以坐出租车去那里吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. The taxi stand is across the road.
dialogue.zh: 可以。出租车站在马路对面。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: You’re welcome.

lessons.title: Shopping & paying
lessons.description: 问价格、选尺码、付款与退换货

phrases.en: What is the price of this coat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, what is the price of this jacket?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，请问这件夹克多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It is forty pounds, and there is a ten percent discount today.
dialogue.zh: 四十英镑，今天还有九折优惠。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Great! Can I pay by card or cash?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我可以刷卡还是付现金？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Both are fine. Here is your receipt.

lessons.title: Health & clinic
lessons.description: 描述不适、预约医生与去药店取药

phrases.en: I have a doctor's appointment at ten.
I need to get some rest.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello, I have an appointment at ten.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我预约了十点看诊。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: What seems to be the problem today?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I have a headache and a sore throat.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Take this medicine after meals and get plenty of rest.
dialogue.zh: 饭后吃这个药，并且多休息。

lessons.title: Friends & chat
lessons.description: 打招呼、邀请朋友与礼貌表达想法

phrases.en: Let me introduce you to my friend.
phrases.zh: 让我把你介绍给我的朋友。

phrases.en: Let's invite our neighbours over for tea.
phrases.zh: 我们邀请邻居过来喝茶吧。

phrases.en: Could you explain how this works?
phrases.zh: 你能说明一下这个怎么用吗？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi! Let me introduce you to my friend.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！让我把你介绍给我的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you! Would you like to join us for tea?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你！想和我们一起喝茶吗？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds lovely. Let's choose a quiet table.
dialogue.zh: 听起来很棒。我们选一张安静的桌子吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I agree with you!
